nom: The Ordinary Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner for Gentle Exfoliation and Hydration

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the toner hydrates without breaking them out and helps keep sebaceous filaments in the T-zone and chin minimal.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe strong hydration and reduced flaking, including relief from winter dehydration and plaque-like dry patches, though one 3-star review found it insufficient for dry mature skin with texture.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report improved texture, evened tone, and no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin frequently report no irritation, reduced redness, and soothing effects, calling it gentler than glycolic acid toners, though a minority with fungal-acne-prone or reactive skin report itchy pimples and worsened breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin report softer, smoother skin and reduced redness, with one noting improved dark spots, though one found the exfoliation too gentle for her texture concerns.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes normal, non-acne-prone skin becoming soft without peeling, but flags a risk of breakouts for acne-prone users based on other reviews.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for mature or aging skin report softer, smoother, more even-toned skin and diminished dark or age spots; no dissent reported for this group beyond one who found it too gentle for her texture.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe significant hydration relief, including resolution of chronic winter flaking and dryness described as 'holy grail'; no negative reports on hydration itself.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea, report notable and sometimes fast reduction in redness and calming of irritation; one reviewer with sebaceous dermatitis instead reports a flare-up.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report the product feels calming and supportive of the skin barrier, with one describing repaired barrier function; no negative reports specific to barrier health.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and acne scarring, describing visible fading within one to two weeks in some cases; no dissent noted.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin describe clearer skin, lighter blemishes, and reduced whiteheads; however, multiple reviewers report new breakouts, cystic-looking pimples, or fungal-acne-like reactions attributed to the yeast content.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the product controls sebaceous filaments and shine without feeling greasy, describing a brief oily feeling right after application that resolves as it absorbs.

aspects.libelle: Bottle dispenser hard to use or leaks

extraits.texte: DO NOT get this product if you're acne prone. it is literally made of YEAST and will cause fungal acne. i was just looking for a milky toner and didn't realize this and was so confused why i was breaking out so bad. breakout prone babes, save your skin and your money. don't get this 🙅🏻‍♀️

Listen, i loved this toner. I loved hudrsting it was and how light weight it was. I wasnt the biggest fan of the smell but i could get over it. Then i started breaking out in these itty bitty pimples, jo big deal i get acne normally. Then they started getting itchy and super red. Dry. Come across a photo of fungal acne and thats EXACTLY what my skin looked like. Fungal acne comes from too much yeast on your skin, and considering this is pretty much yeast, i knee it was this product. I wish it worked for me.

I never take the time to leave reviews, but this had a hand in changing my skin. This significantly helled my redness almost instantly. It calmed my skin, helped repair my skin barrier and all over moisturized really well. I use this with my Avene Tolerance cream, and I swear I'll never have to buy another duo again.

This is the best exfoliant I have tried. I only use this at night with the skin cycling method. The next day my skin is so hydrated and smooth. It's a noticeable difference! Even when I fall off my routine, I rely on this product to reset my skin. I have dehydrated/textured/dull/combo skin. Before this I was using the glycolic acid which was becoming too harsh. I'm so happy I made the switch!

I bought this toner several months ago, I'm on my third bottle now so I obviously like the results. I have mature skin that has some redness and texture. Gycolic toners are now too harsh but this one is very soothing and leaves my skin soft and smooth. There has been improvement in the redness, too. The smell is of yeast so no flowery smell but that doesn't bother me.

I have chronicallg dry skin in the winter with major flaking (almost in plaques) and redness. I haven't had any AT. ALL. so far this winter!!! I'm out in the cold a lot too which doesn't help and this has been such a game changer!

This for sure works to hydrate and really get the bouncy-milky look that you would want for a toner, and for the price compared to other brands how can one say no? But for people with sebaceous dermatitis like me, this has fermented yeast that will activate a flare, just use with caution.
